title: Prevalence of Spasticity in Adults With Mental Retardation Living in the Community
brief_summary: This survey aims to investigate the prevalence of spasticity among adults who live in community settings in Davidson County, Tennessee. The treatment of spasticity in those who live in community homes could significantly increase a person's quality of life by allowing them to participate more independently in activities of daily living, or by making assistance easier for caregivers.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Adult (18 and over) with mental retardation
* Living in a community home in Davidson County, Tennessee.

Exclusion Criteria:

None.
study_population: Adults with mental retardation living in community homes in Davidson County, TN.
